flags: Option D is 90°, although the question calls the parking angle acute. It requires 5 m of depth and does not affect the answer.

question: A site has only 4 m of depth perpendicular to the driving aisle, and the parking space marking lines are 5 m long. Which of the following parking angles (the acute angle between the marking lines and the driving aisle) allows the spaces to fit?
solution: The required depth is \(5\times\sin\theta\). At \(45^\circ\), it is approximately \(3.5\text{ m}\le4\text{ m}\). At \(60^\circ\), it is approximately 4.33 m; at \(75^\circ\), approximately 4.83 m; and at \(90^\circ\), 5 m. All of these exceed 4 m.
